notes.title: BRaG: LIMITED OPEN PLAYTEST
notes.content:
Ready to brew up some fun? We're inviting you to playtest the pre-alpha version of Barista: Rise and Grind and share your feedback. Jump in, make some coffee, and help us make the game better. Your input matters!

[h2]📌 What's Included:[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✅ Core game loop – From bean to cup!
[*] ✅ Character customization – Make your barista your own.
[*] ✅ Essential recipes & brewing methods – Master the classics.
[*] ✅ AI customers – Keep ‘em caffeinated and happy!
[/list]

[h2]🔍 What We’re Looking For:[/h2]
We’re all about [i]smooth gameplay and rich flavor[/i]—so tell us how the experience feels! No need to hunt for bugs right now, just share what’s fun and what’s not.

[h2]☕ What's Brewing for Future Playtests:[/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ Edit mode – Redesign your café vibe.
[*] ✨ Shop system – Upgrade your setup.
[*] ✨ More customization options – New styles and gear.
[*] ✨ Additional machines – Brew like a pro.
[*] ✨ Enhanced AI interactions – Smarter, thirstier customers.
[*] ✨ Clean and Maintenance mode – Keep your café spotless.
[*] ✨ And more...
[/list]

[h3]💬 Join our [url=http://discord.gg/pixelz]Discord[/url] to share your feedback, chat with us, or connect with the community. We’d love to hear what you think! [/h3]

notes.title: CLOSED DISCORD PLAYTEST - MVP 0.1
notes.content:
[h1]LIVE CLOSED DISCORD PLAYTEST[/h1]

Hey all! We are at a point in development where we want your feedback for some of the core gameplay of the game. The playtest is available only to those on our [url=http://discord.gg/pixelz] Discord [/url] since we want to keep the feedback close to us. 

We would really appreciate you fill out the survey on our [url=http://discord.gg/pixelz] Discord [/url] as well after testing the game. 

Cheers
